Dataset Card for CML-TTS
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

CML-TTS is a recursive acronym for CML-Multi-Lingual-TTS, a Text-to-Speech (TTS) dataset developed at the Center of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence (CEIA) of the Federal University of Goias (UFG).
CML-TTS is a dataset comprising audiobooks sourced from the public domain books of Project Gutenberg, read by volunteers from the LibriVox project. The dataset includes recordings in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Polish… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ylacombe/cml-tts.
